last.summary: Addressed the review: ByteExact.lean now has #guards (run in every build) that generate in Lean the under/over-10000-byte periodic inputs (ab*4999, ab*5500, a*9999, a*11000, the 1000-byte LCG pattern *9 and *11) and compare compress output at levels 1, 5 and 9 by length and bzip2 CRC32 against the vendored C bzip2's vectors in tests/vectors/byte-exact (values computed from those files). Module doc updated to no longer defer to check.py. Confirmed a wrong CRC makes the build fail (ByteExact.lean:145 guard error), then restored it. The merged origin/master (decompress) still passes. verify.sh: 'verify: packages: ok', 'sources: ok', 'build: ok', 'style: ok', 'axioms: ok', 'lint: ok', 'test: ok', 'verify: ok' (lake test: 53 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed). git status clean; the diff vs origin/master touches only Compress/*, tests/Bzip2/Test/ByteExact.lean and tests/vectors/byte-exact/*. fuzz/compress_diff.c does not exist on this branch, so the fuzz item does not apply.
